metadata.time_note: Storm Data entry times should be reviewed in local Standard Time (ST), not daylight time. Candidate reports include standard_time_display.
metadata.tornado_track_policy: Tornado tracks must come from DAT. NCEI begin/end coordinates are not used as a tornado track substitute.

properties.event_narrative: A member of the public reported a waterspout that had occurred around 5:19 PM EST via social media. The waterspout was associated with a cloud line_ and occurred to the southwest of Higgs Beach. The photo with the report showed a very skinny condensation funnel that extended approximately 1/4 of the way to the surface from the cloud base at a 45-degree angle. There was no spray ring visible. The waterspout was reported to have lasted a few minutes.
